title: Memory Tensor RT Semantic Governance
purpose: Freeze the semantic meaning of the Memory Tensor RT primitives while allowing mathematical implementations and neuroscience mappings to evolve independently.

RT.definition: Real Truth; the complete relational expression as one.

TA.definition: The individual's complete memory tensor expressed as gradients.

m.definition: Implied recall target induced by observation or conversation.

C.definition: Confidence (felt correctness) resulting from local resolution.

neuroscience.restriction: Mappings remain analogical until experimentally supported.

prohibited_claims: The brain has been shown to store memories as tensor arrays.
The framework experimentally explains the Mandela Effect.
approved_claims: RT is inferred through local comparisons.
Memory is modeled as an output rather than a stored object.
The framework is a provisional formal model.
